findings.summary: Frozen-count delta: full make verify is 2890 passed + 1 skipped (exit 0, zero deselect) vs the spec's literal '2887 passed + 1 skipped'; the +3 is exactly the three new whitelist guards acceptance criterion 2 itself mandates (19 d12b nodeids = 16 original + 3 new), so the clause's operative intent -- all green including the formerly-red test -- holds.

Route-A tolerance necessarily generalizes one step past the spec's literal wording: an existing machine-artifact whitelist entry that does not quote the phrase is also tolerated, because the literal 'existing paths must contain the phrase' reading would be red in this very unit tree (its ⑫-c approved.md is phrase-free; repo-wide grep shows the phrase only at tests/test_d12b_audit_note_targets.py:73). The generalization is bounded to .dev-dispatch/ and .dd-evidence/ prefixes, product-surface entries still must exist and contain the phrase, and repo-hits-subset-of-whitelist exactness is preserved, so the anti-weakening constraints hold in both required contexts.
